outcome: cerebral and splanchnic fractional tissue oxygen extraction (FTOEc and FTOEs)
ratio of arterial oxygen partial pressure (PaO2) to fraction of inspired oxygen (FiO2)
cohort: 27 infants with isolated congenital diaphragmatic hernia (CDH) who were treated with vasopressin for systemic hypotension and pulmonary hypertension,  at the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) between May 2014 to January 2019
finding: Early vasopressin infusion in CDH infants with pulmonary hypertension improved oxygenation index and near-infrared spectroscopy after 12 and 24 h of infusion.
